identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of ZG006 in Participants With Neuroendocrine Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Study Evaluating the Preliminary Efficacy and Safety of ZG006 in Participants With Metastatic Neuroendocrine Prostate Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a multicenter, open-label Phase II study, aimed at exploring the preliminary efficacy and safety of ZG006 in patients with advanced metastatic NEPC who have previously failed standard treatment.

armGroups.label: Part2
armGroups.description: Participants will receive the RP2D identified in Part 1 of the study.

armGroups.label: Part 1
armGroups.description: The preliminary efficacy and safety of ZG006 at the two determined potential Phase II recommended doses (10 mg and 30 mg) will be assessed in Participants with advanced metastatic NEPC.

interventions.name: ZG006
interventions.description: ZG006 will be administered as an intravenous (IV) infusion.

primaryOutcomes.description: mBOR will be assessed per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) 1.1 with Prostate Cancer Working Group 3 (PCWG3) modifications.
